name: Prepare for Battle

angles.text: As a front-line fighter, you know this gathering comes before combat. Check your gear and form ranks beside your allies as the company prepares to march.

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist organizes the Peacekeepers' muster in the Gustberry Lowlands. She oversees final preparations along the eastern road leading north out of town before the forces depart.
The Peacekeepers are an organized local defense force. They are gathering to face a looming threat outside of town.
The Gustberry Lowlands is where local defense forces gather. Their staging ground lies along the road leading north out of town.
The Peacekeepers are preparing to march out in force. They call on capable allies to check their gear and gather at the edge of town before the company departs.
faq.q: What are the Peacekeepers preparing for?

faq.answer: The company meets along the eastern road leading north out of town. There, its members can gather in formation before marching into the field.
faq.q: Where is the rendezvous point for the march?

aliases: we are as ready as we will ever be
faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist inspects the assembled ranks and calls the roll. Then the forces march into danger.
faq.q: What happens once everyone is assembled?

sections.body: The Peacekeepers, the local defense forces, have called their troops and volunteers to arms as tensions rise. Secure your equipment, ready your weapons, and join the company as it forms for an organized march into the surrounding territory.
sections.title: A Call to Muster

sections.body: The company gathers along the eastern road leading north out of town into the Gustberry Lowlands. There, organizer Valennia Stormfist inspects the fighters and calls the roll. Then the company marches into danger.
sections.title: The Gathering at Gustberry Lowlands

summary: The Peacekeepers are gathering in town to march into the surrounding territory. You are called to make your final preparations and meet Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands before the company departs.
attribution: In-game quest text: Prepare for Battle
